lines.zh: 我像个普通玩家一样走着。
lines.en: I walk like any ordinary player.
My boots land loudly.
I head your way.

lines.zh: 我边走边看手上的东西。
lines.en: I walk while checking what I hold.

lines.zh: 我绕过那滩水，像你一样。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle, as you would.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤和活人没差别。
lines.en: My skin looks no different from yours.

lines.zh: 我走路时手臂摆得很自然。
lines.en: My arms swing naturally.
I come down the hillside.
Two blocks a stride. In a hurry.
Where you go, I go.
A name floats above me.
I do not pant, but I move fast.
I stand, facing your way.
I raise a hand as if greeting.
I crouch as if sorting a pack.

lines.zh: 我不动，看你会不会过来。
lines.en: I wait to see if you approach.

lines.zh: 我的脸和活人一模一样。
lines.en: My face is exactly a living one's.
I watch the sky as if for rain.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤边缘有点翘起。
lines.en: The edge of my skin is peeling up.

lines.zh: 我站在村口，被当成路人。
lines.en: At the village gate, I pass as a passerby.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤有时候太白了。
lines.en: My skin is sometimes too pale.
I do not breathe. That gives me away.
Hello. Walking together?
Nice gear you have.
I do not know you, yet you look familiar.
My name? Look above my head.
You came alone too?
Have we met somewhere?

lines.zh: 我顶着名单上的名字走近。
lines.en: I approach wearing a name from the list.
I have your face now.
Shall we trade something?
Your hands shake. Why?
My face shifts a little.
Did not expect that.
I step back and raise my sword.
A cut opens in the skin.

lines.zh: 这一剑划开了我借来的皮。
lines.en: That sword cut open my borrowed skin.
This body feels pain too.
I brace on the trunk.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起了什么。
lines.en: That reminded me of something.

lines.zh: 你看见我流血了，放心了？
lines.en: You saw blood. Relieved?
Still here. Do not celebrate.
I do want what you are holding.
Let me see that iron.
A trade, then?
That food. I will take it.
Your pack holds good things.
Hand it over. I do not bite.
That sword is a fine one.
Food is of little use to me.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我来拿。
lines.en: Set it down and I will collect it.

lines.zh: 你舍不得？那就别拿出来了。
lines.en: Reluctant? Then do not show it.
Bumped you. Bad luck.

lines.zh: 我们身高一样，撞得正好。
lines.en: Same height. We met square.
You back off and see my face.
Do not shove. I am only passing.

lines.zh: 我的身体和活人一样硬。
lines.en: I am as solid as anyone alive.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你手上的东西掉了。
lines.en: One bump and you drop it.
You nearly knocked my head off.
Face to face, neither gives ground.
Step back. I am not moving.
Only after the bump do you understand.
I only look like a person.

lines.zh: 这问题对一个玩家很奇怪。
lines.en: Odd question for a player.
We do not come about that way.
A name on a list is enough.
Stop asking. I am not real.
This skin is borrowed.
You ask like a villager.
I only attack. Nothing else.
Many names. No companions.
Passing on that topic.
I will take this iron.

lines.zh: 我披着你的皮肤，认得吗？
lines.en: I wear your skin; do you know me?
Unclaimed, is it not?
I bend like a person would.
This head wears the same skin as mine.
Into the pack it goes.

lines.zh: 捡东西的动作我很熟练。
lines.en: I am practiced at picking up.
This shield is useless to me.
Your arrow. Keep it.
I take it and leave. No explanation.
You are not my namesake. Good.
I read your name.
I start this one.

lines.zh: 我的脸和你的名字，都是借来的。
lines.en: This face and name are both borrowed.

lines.zh: 名单翻到你了，跟我走吧。
lines.en: The list has reached you; come along.
I come at you. Quickly.
The target is you, no one else.

lines.zh: 我们看起来一样，打起来也一样。
lines.en: We look alike. We hit alike.

lines.zh: 别跑，你跑不过这个名字。
lines.en: Do not run; you cannot outrun this name.
The list gave me this task.
I have your pack marked.
I have wanted this a while.
I said your name right.

lines.zh: 我顶着别人的名字，来杀你。
lines.en: I wear another's name and come to kill you.
Do not ask why. I do not know.
I came around behind you.
I copy your footwork.
You raise your arm. So do I.

lines.zh: 我的剑法是从你身上学的。
lines.en: I learned my swordsmanship from watching you.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡不住同类的剑。
lines.en: Your shield will not stop one of your own.

lines.zh: 我知道你什么时候会转身。
lines.en: I know when you will turn.
Three blocks apart. Perfect.
Your shield drifts half an inch left.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了节奏，我的名字也一样。
lines.en: Your breathing lost its rhythm, and so did my name.
You backed to the water's edge.
I know this terrain.
One more step and you reach the village.
Two blocks behind you.
You slowed a fraction.
I tire too. I just do not stop.

lines.zh: 我们绕着这棵树转了三圈。
lines.en: Three laps around this tree.

lines.zh: 你把盾举高，脚下就空了。
lines.en: Shield high, feet bare.

lines.zh: 我的名字和皮肤，都写着别人。
lines.en: My name and skin both belong to someone else.
I counted your arrows.
I look exactly like you.
Do not turn. Do not look away.
My sword is as quick as yours.
This one comes from your left.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一剑，还有下一剑。
lines.en: You blocked one. There is another.

lines.zh: 我的脸没有表情，手很快。
lines.en: My face stays blank. My hands are fast.
You retreat. I press on.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护甲上。
lines.en: That landed on your armor.
You should not have given me an opening.

lines.zh: 我的手背划到你脸上了。
lines.en: My hand grazed your face.
We fight identically.

lines.zh: 这一剑，和你的起手一样。
lines.en: This thrust mirrors your own opening move.
One more and your shield splits.

lines.zh: 我出手不犹豫，这点和你不同。
lines.en: I do not hesitate. That is the difference.
Your foot slips on gravel.
That one was not cruel.
I strike while looking in your eyes.
Too hasty. Your shield shows a gap.
We swapped places. Do not panic.

lines.zh: 这一剑很熟吧，是你的招式。
lines.en: Familiar? That was your own move.
Your blood differs from mine.
I lower my blade. You still stand.

lines.zh: 一个玩家出现在山脊上。
lines.en: A player appears on the ridge.
The list reads a name, and I come.
Someone walks this way.
My name floats in the air.

lines.zh: 你听见靴子声，以为是同伴。
lines.en: Boot steps. You think it a friend.

lines.zh: 我从山脊那边走来，像个人。
lines.en: I walk over the ridge, looking human.
Skin forms first, then the face.
I walk down the slope.
A stranger in the village.
I look a lot like you.
Someone waves from a distance.
Not a villager. A player.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的皮肤，起泡了。
lines.en: Fire blisters my skin.
I fell from the slope and my leg bends.
Water enters my lungs. Cold.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的皮肤掀掉一块。
lines.en: The blast tears a patch of skin.
An arrow lands square in my shoulder.
Magic locks my movement.
I never eat. I only grow light.
Lightning struck. My skin is charred.
I fall into the void. My name remains.
